sentence: Responsibilities: Join our client's Supply Chain Technology team as a Product Manager for Order Management Systems, focusing on developing strategies and solutions to optimize order management processes.
This role will play a crucial part in improving efficiency and customer satisfaction in the order fulfillment process.
Role Summary: Translate business strategy into technology product strategy, owning the product roadmap for Order Management Systems.
suggestions: owning the product roadmap for Order Management Systems

sentence: Develop a deep understanding of order management processes and drive prioritization of product capabilities.
Represent the business throughout the technology development process, documenting requirements, and maintaining and prioritizing the product backlog.
suggestions: maintaining and prioritizing the product backlog

sentence: Regularly collaborate with Businesses to identify and define new capability requirements and sequencing based on business value.
suggestions: identify and define new capability requirements

sentence: Develop a complete vision for new or changing features related to Order Management Systems, including performance metrics and evolution plans.
Mentor and develop junior product management talent.
Work with a significant degree of autonomy.
Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering preferred, or equivalent experience.
3+ years of experience in Supply Chain Technology.
2+ years of experience in the Order Management domain within the Supply Chain (JDE/D365 experience is preferred).
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, using data to solve complex problems.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.
Additional Information: the client offers two work locations to choose from: the Duluth or Atlanta office.
